Inter, self hosted

Downloaded 5 September 2026.

Font files, verified byte for byte against the bytes served on the date above:
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7.woff2      latin
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa25L7SUc.woff2   latin-ext
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa0ZL7SUc.woff2   cyrillic
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa2JL7SUc.woff2   cyrillic-ext

The addresses were read from the stylesheet returned by
  https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap

The v20 segment is a Google Fonts delivery path. It is not a released version number of Inter.

Licence file, source stated by the person who downloaded it, not independently verified:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/inter/OFL.txt

Four character sets are kept: latin, latin-ext, cyrillic, cyrillic-ext.
The greek, greek-ext and vietnamese sets were downloaded and deliberately not included,
because no surface of this application renders those scripts. A character outside the
included ranges falls back to a system font.

The files are variable fonts covering the weight axis from 100 to 900 in one file per set.
The interface uses 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 850 and 900. No italic is used anywhere,
so no italic file is included.
